_comment: U8 fill-in data (rulings UL9, UG4; schema in tests/test_legal_docs_u8.py). null = not answered or not recorded yet; test_t2_no_unresolved_placeholder reports every null. The owner's answers come from the U8 input form; the seven flags are recorded by the orchestrator from a names-only read of production (never by an agent, never by the owner). scripts/fill_in_legal.py applies this file to the legal markdown and re-renders the landing regions; it refuses to write anything while a required value is null.
_answers_comment: deletion_variant '043' only after migration 043 is applied and POSTCHECK passed (else 'old'); territories 'bahrain' | 'gcc'; d3 'A' | 'B'; d5 'A' (individual) | 'B' (organisation, needs CR_NUMBER); trade_name '' for none; inapp_notif_clause false until issue #264 ships; openai_store_pinned true only once store=False is pinned on main (U3c).
_placeholders_comment: Owner / orchestrator values: CONTROLLER_NAME (exact legal name as on the Apple membership), POSTAL_ADDRESS, PRIVACY_EMAIL, SUPPORT_EMAIL, CR_NUMBER (d5 'B' only; null under 'A'), IP_OWNER (the owner's name, or 'the publisher' until the IP licence exists), GOVERNING_LAW (e.g. 'the Kingdom of Bahrain'), WITHDRAW_PATH (from U3b's merged code), SECURITY_LOG_RETENTION and ANON_LOG_RETENTION (wording that reads after 'for' and after a colon: 'no fixed period' unless the cleanup is live; a fixed period such as '12 months' only after the DEL-FOLLOWUPS cleanup (migration 044) is merged and its Railway cron registered, UL8, recorded as RETENTION_CLEANUP_LIVE 'true'; the fill-in refuses a value naming a number or a duration otherwise), HOSTING_REGIONS ('' when unknown; the only key that may be ''), LEGAL_BASIS_COUNSEL and TRANSFER_BASIS_COUNSEL (counsel's wording, needed only when counsel_review is true; null otherwise, since a value no selected variant uses is refused). Keys ending in _AR are the Arabic documents' twins. Derived by the fill-in from the answers and scripts/legal_variants_u8.json, always null here: TRADE_NAME_CLAUSE, MINORS_CLAUSE, YOUTUBE_CLAUSE, INAPP_NOTIF_CLAUSE, HOSTING_REGIONS_CLAUSE, TRANSFER_BASIS, DELETION_SECTION, DPO_CONTACT.
_placeholder_answers_comment: Answers kept under placeholders (the top-level keys are fixed by the schema in tests/test_legal_docs_u8.py); null is each one's documented default, so the fill-in never reports them missing; the orchestrator records them from facts at the fill-in (UP6). CONTROLLER_COUNTRY: null or 'Bahrain'; privacy sections 7 and 10 name Bahrain, so any other country is refused until they are re-drafted (UP4 A12a). RETENTION_CLEANUP_LIVE: 'true' | 'false' | null (null = not live); 'true' only once the DEL-FOLLOWUPS cleanup (migration 044) is merged and its Railway cron registered (UL8, UP4 A11). REFERRAL_PUSH_DISPLAY_NAME_ONLY: 'true' | 'false' | null (null = 'false'); 'true' only once U3c (the referral push shows the display name, never the email prefix) is on main; 'false' publishes 'your display name or the first part of your email address' (UP4 A15; the merge gate requires 'true'). DPO_CONTACT_DETAILS and DPO_CONTACT_DETAILS_AR: null (no data protection officer or guardian: the policy names only the privacy email) or the officer's name and contact, e.g. 'Jane Doe, dpo@example.com', shown in privacy sections 1 and 16 (UP4 A12c). The Cloudflare line of privacy section 5 does not depend on these answers: it stays whatever PRIVACY_EMAIL and SUPPORT_EMAIL are, because the landing pages publish support@qaren.app outside the legal regions (fix P1 amends UP4 A12b).
